## Automated Meeting Notes Email

Formats and distributes meeting notes to all attendees.

**Flow:**
1. Webhook receives meeting notes data
2. Code formats into professional HTML with sections
3. Gmail sends to all attendees
4. Log to Sheets

**Webhook payload:**
```json
{
  "title": "Sprint Review",
  "date": "2025-01-15",
  "attendees": [
    {"name": "John", "email": "john@co.com", "role": "PM"},
    {"name": "Jane", "email": "jane@co.com"}
  ],
  "decisions": ["Approved feature X", "Delayed Y to Q2"],
  "actionItems": [
    {"task": "Write spec", "owner": "John", "deadline": "Jan 20", "priority": "high"}
  ],
  "notes": "General discussion...",
  "nextMeeting": "Jan 22 at 2pm"
}
```
